name: Injury Echo
body:
School transmutation; Level precog 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You manifest an injury from the target’s future or past. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage when you cast this spell. The target must succeed at a Will saving throw or take 1d6 damage of the chosen type.
